朝他扔了一个烂番茄: threw a rotten tomato at them

放了一只乌鸦落在他头上: set a raven on their head
鸦木布拉夫的乌鸦，落在多嘴的人头上叫个不停。: A Ravenswood Bluff raven. It perches on chatterboxes and won't stop cawing.
给他套上了毒舌笼头: strapped a scold's bridle on them
旧时专罚多嘴、搬弄是非的人的铁笼头。: The old iron cage once used to punish gossips and loose tongues.
